name: icon
description: Sizes an inline SVG to the surrounding text and aligns it with the text beside it.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between the icon and its text.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: How the icon lines up with the text: centered on the line, or on the baseline.

children.description: The icon, an inline SVG, sized to one em.

a11y.notes: When the icon sits beside text, give the SVG aria-hidden="true" so the text is the name. When it stands alone, give the SVG role="img" and an aria-label.
